description: This file contains test functions for the 'operator' package, specifically testing device registration, management, and grouping in the 'devices_test.go' file of the Android Cuttlefish frontend's device operator module.

methods.name: TestNewDevice
methods.description: Tests creation of a new device using 'newDevice' function.

methods.name: TestDeviceRegister
methods.description: Tests the registration, unregistration, message sending, and disconnection behavior of devices.

methods.name: TestPoolRegister
methods.description: Tests the device pool's registration and retrieval functionalities.

methods.name: TestPoolPreRegister
methods.description: Tests pre-registration, cancellation, and subsequent registration of devices.

methods.name: TestListDevices
methods.description: Verifies device listing functionality after various registrations and unregistrations.

methods.name: MakeInfo
methods.description: Creates a map with device group information.

methods.name: TestListDevicesByGroup
methods.description: Checks listing devices filtered by group ID.

methods.name: TestListDevicesEmpty
methods.description: Ensures device list APIs return empty when no devices are registered.

methods.name: TestGroupIdFromPrivateData
methods.description: Verifies extraction of group ID from device private data.

methods.name: TestListGroups
methods.description: Tests listing all device groups after registrations and unregisters.

methods.name: TestDefaultGroup
methods.description: Checks behavior of default group management when devices have various descriptors.
